title: Calycosin action against atherosclerosis: integrating network pharmacology and in-silico investigation.
authors: Xu, Hongyuan; Wu, Kunpeng; Guo, Chao; Zhong, Guoqiang
one_liner_zh: 该文通过网络药理学和分子对接研究毛蕊异黄酮抗动脉粥样硬化的靶点，虽涉及蛋白-小分子对接，但非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Atherosclerosis, caused by lipid deposit in the arterial wall for narrowing the arteries, is an increased risk factor of developing heart failure. Presently, clinical first-line drug therapy can be found with side effects, and thus new substitute medication should be developed needfully. Calycosin is one of the most bioactive products refined from natural plant, and it exerts promising cardiovascular protective effect. However, the pharmacological mechanisms of calycosin against atherosclerosis have not been elaborated. In this study, a systematic network pharmacology combined with molecular docking analysis was used to reveal the interaction activity and biological target in calycosin against atherosclerosis. We screened all preparative targets linked to calycosin and atherosclerosis from the available public databases. These results indicated total 409 putative targets in calycosin action, 71 of which were interacted with atherosclerosis. Further biological docking analysis suggested that calycosin displayed the powerful binding affinities with target proteins, including interleukin-6 (IL6) and mitogen-activated protein kinase 3 (MAPK3) MAPK3. Then enrichment findings revealed that calycosin action to treat atherosclerosis might be related to inhibition of inflammatory reaction and oxidative stress through modulating nucleolus transcription factor for improving lipid metabolism. In conclusion, the anti-atherosclerotic targets and molecular mechanisms in calycosin action were revealed systematically through preclinical evaluation. And calycosin may be a potential natural compound for the treatment of atherosclerosis.
abstract_zh: 动脉粥样硬化，由动脉壁脂质沉积导致动脉狭窄，是发展为心力衰竭的风险因素增加。目前，临床一线药物治疗存在副作用，因此亟需开发新的替代药物。毛蕊异黄酮（calycosin）是从天然植物中提取的最具生物活性的产物之一，展现出良好的心血管保护作用。然而，毛蕊异黄酮抗动脉粥样硬化的药理学机制尚未阐明。本研究采用系统网络药理学结合分子对接分析，揭示毛蕊异黄酮抗动脉粥样硬化的相互作用活性及生物靶点。我们从可用的公共数据库中筛选了所有与毛蕊异黄酮和动脉粥样硬化相关的预备靶点。结果表明，毛蕊异黄酮作用中共有409个推定靶点，其中71个与动脉粥样硬化相互作用。进一步的生物对接分析提示，毛蕊异黄酮与靶蛋白（包括白细胞介素-6（interleukin-6, IL6）和丝裂原活化蛋白激酶3（mitogen-activated protein kinase 3, MAPK3））表现出强大的结合亲和力。随后富集分析揭示，毛蕊异黄酮治疗动脉粥样硬化的作用可能与其通过调节核仁转录因子改善脂质代谢，从而抑制炎症反应和氧化应激有关。总之，通过临床前评估，系统揭示了毛蕊异黄酮作用的抗动脉粥样硬化靶点及分子机制。毛蕊异黄酮可能成为治疗动脉粥样硬化的潜在天然化合物。
